purpose: First-connection and low-cost re-entry map for reasoning agents using GitHub. Resolve current main from GitHub; never trust an embedded commit SHA.
connector_rules: Freeze exact main HEAD and tree before substantive reads or staging.
Use search for discovery only; exact refs, trees, blobs, files, tests, and CI establish snapshot truth.
Batch independent reads at one pinned ref and serialize dependent writes.
Track read/write/dependency/protected sets only as ephemeral task state.
Use one Git-object candidate commit for coupled changes.
Treat a moved main as awareness before conflict and compare the last accepted head directly with the newest head.
Inspect and absorb useful concurrent work when it changes an active owner, premise, test, implementation, or evidence route.
Bound publication retries and preserve the staged overlay instead of restarting the task.
Validation is target-SHA-bound; only checks that actually execute may be reported as passes.
Use open CODEX issues only for concrete capability debt blocked by the current connector/runtime.
reentry_note: This file is a route index, not repository truth. Canonical owners and live skill bytes win if it drifts.
